newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement slips to 4.145 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement slips to 4.145 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended June 14 was 4,145,695 gallons compared with 4,889,350 gallons last week.
Imports were 127,711 gallons compared with 92,565 gallons the previous week. There were 53,470 domestic receipts for this week compared with 744 the previous week.
Retail movement was 567,441 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,083,395 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 146,681,692 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 239,458,996 gallons.
